subject.title: [Feature]: Remove the Context Profile presets card from Quick Settings

question: Should Quick Settings remove the Context Profile presets entirely and rely on Advanced settings plus a slim unsaved-changes action bar for those agent-default edits?
rationale: This deliberately removes a prominent Simple Settings workflow, and the protected maintainer label plus issue text request explicit product approval before implementation.

options.title: Approve focused removal
options.body: Remove the preset card and preset machinery, keep the existing config keys editable in Advanced, and require proof that all dirty Quick Settings edits can still be saved, applied, or discarded.

options.title: Keep a smaller profile surface
options.body: Retain a collapsed or renamed Context Profile entry if maintainers still want quick access to context-tuning presets despite the prominence concern.

options.title: Defer to broader Settings review
options.body: Leave the current card in place until a larger Settings information-architecture pass decides which expert controls belong in Simple mode.

recommendation.title: Approve focused removal
recommendation.body: Remove the preset card and preset machinery, keep the existing config keys editable in Advanced, and require proof that all dirty Quick Settings edits can still be saved, applied, or discarded.

likelyOwner.reason: They requested the product decision and have the most recent related Settings declutter history.
